theorems.name: Submission.dgoj_exists_orthonormal_frame_range
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Injective F → ∃ τ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = LinearMap.range (F : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)
